title_zh: Man’s best friends — 第11节可背诵讲义
body_en: Dogs and cats can be our best friends. They need food, water, clean space, and kind hands. Train a pet with care, not anger. If you cannot keep an animal, help at an animal home or feed birds in winter. Friendship with animals teaches care for others.
body_zh: 猫狗可以是我们最好的朋友。它们需要食物、水、干净空间和温柔的手。用关心而非愤怒训练宠物。若不能养宠物，去动物之家帮忙或在冬天喂鸟。与动物的友谊教我们关爱他人。
